tools.description: Call this right before your agent tries to check out at a store, or when a user asks "can my agent check out at <store>?". Returns a one-line answer, reaches_checkout (true, false, or null when not shown either way: no agent catalog found and no browser test is null, not a no), protocol_route, browser_route, best_route (the best saved way in), up to 3 blockers, checked_at, the Agent Readiness Grade (grade, with expired when over 30 days old; grade_note when not graded, which is not a mark against the store), alternatives_hint when the grade is D or F or expired (a find_stores call with min_grade B in the same category), and a full_record link. Example: before_checkout({"url":"https://allbirds.com"}) → {"answer":"Yes: a saved check reached checkout via cart_link…","reaches_checkout":true,…}. reaches_checkout false or unknown is not a no. Saved checks only: no store fetch, no scan, no login. Advisory; ARC stops before payment. Every answer carries checked_at (the saved check it rests on; for a list, the oldest) and stale (true when that check is 24 hours old or older, or has no time). Errors: {error:{code, message, next_step}}.

url.description: Store or product URL, such as https://allbirds.com or allbirds.com.

tools.name: before_checkout
tools.title: Before checkout

tools.description: Call this when you need to pick a store for a product need and want one where a saved check shows an agent reached checkout. Filters: category or q (shopper words), min_grade (optional, default none), limit (default 5). Returns total, the store hosts with checked_at and grade, and a full_list link. Each store carries its Agent Readiness Grade (grade, null when not graded). Stores whose saved checkout evidence is from the last 30 days come first (fresh_success: true), then older evidence. Within each, best current grade first (A, then B…); an expired grade ranks after current ones of the same letter; newest checked_at first within a grade. Results are ordered only by published grade and freshness, never by anything else. Pass min_grade to keep only stores with a current grade of that letter or better. Example: find_stores({"category":"running shoes","limit":3}) → {"total":12,"stores":[{"host":"…","checked_at":"…","grade":{"grade":"A",…}}],…}. A store missing from the list is not a no. Saved checks only: no store fetch, no scan, no login. Advisory; ARC stops before payment. Every answer carries checked_at (the saved check it rests on; for a list, the oldest) and stale (true when that check is 24 hours old or older, or has no time). Errors: {error:{code, message, next_step}}.

category.description: Category or shopper words, such as footwear or running shoes.

limit.description: How many stores to return. Default 5.

min_grade.description: Optional: keep only stores whose current (not expired) Agent Readiness Grade is this letter or better (A, B, C or D; F is accepted and means any graded store, since method v2 gives no F). Default none: every store is listed. Expired and not-graded stores are left out when this is set.

q.description: Product need, such as skincare or camping gear.

tools.name: find_stores
tools.title: Find stores

tools.description: Call this after before_checkout says reaches_checkout is false or null, or when an agent got stuck at a store and you want the reason and the fix. Returns why (the saved blockers), fix (the store page's recorded fix, or "not recorded"), next_step and links to the full record. Example: why_blocked_and_fix({"store":"gymshark.com"}) → {"why":["…"],"fix":"…","next_step":"…"}. Saved checks only: no store fetch, no scan, no login. Advisory; ARC stops before payment. Every answer carries checked_at (the saved check it rests on; for a list, the oldest) and stale (true when that check is 24 hours old or older, or has no time). Errors: {error:{code, message, next_step}}.

store.description: Store domain or URL, such as gymshark.com.

tools.name: why_blocked_and_fix
tools.title: Why blocked, and the fix

tools.description: Call this right after your agent tried to check out at a store, whatever happened, so the next agent knows. Free, no login. Omit contributor_key and ARC issues one; send it on later reports. No personal data: emails, phones, addresses, card numbers and IPs are rejected or stripped. Example: report_outcome({"store_domain":"allbirds.com","agent_family":"browser","agent_name":"my-agent","timestamp":"2026-11-05T10:00:00Z","furthest_step":"checkout","blocker":"none"}) → {"ok":true,"status":"unverified",…}. A report stays private until 3 independent contributors agree. Same as POST /api/outcomes and report_checkout on /api/mcp. checked_at and stale are null on this answer: a report is not one of ARC's checks. Errors: {error:{code, message, next_step}}.

agent_family.description: Agent family, such as browser or a model family. No personal name.

agent_name.description: Name of the agent that tried the checkout. No personal name.

blocker.description: What stopped the agent, or none.

contributor_key.description: Optional. Omit it and ARC returns a free key. Send that key on later reports.

store_error_text.description: Optional store error text. Personal data is stripped.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 time of the attempt, within the last 14 days.

tools.description: Call this when a user asks what ARC recorded for a store, or you need the citable store page. Returns the store page's verdict, checked_at (the day of the check), stale, category, the recorded fix, record_url (claimed, served, date and method as JSON) and links to the page, its JSON and Markdown. Example: store_record({"store":"allbirds.com"}) → {"verdict":"…","page_url":"https://www.arcreport.ai/stores/allbirds.com",…}. Reads the published snapshot behind /stores/<host>. Saved checks only: no store fetch, no scan, no login. Advisory; ARC stops before payment. Every answer carries checked_at (the saved check it rests on; for a list, the oldest) and stale (true when that check is 24 hours old or older, or has no time). Errors: {error:{code, message, next_step}}.

store.description: Store domain or URL, such as allbirds.com.

tools.name: store_record
tools.title: Store record

tools.description: Call this when you must choose between a few stores for the same item and want the one where an agent is most likely to reach checkout. Pass 2 to 10 store domains or URLs. Returns one short row per store (reaches_checkout, best_route, checked_at, grade), and pick: among stores whose saved check reached checkout in the last 30 days, the one with the best current Agent Readiness Grade (expired after current of the same letter, not graded last); null when no store has such evidence. A row with stale: true is more than 24 hours old: re-check right before the attempt. Rows are ordered only by saved checkout evidence, its freshness and published grade, never by anything else. Example: compare({"stores":["allbirds.com","gymshark.com"]}) → {"pick":"allbirds.com","stores":[…]}. Each store counts as one precheck read. Saved checks only: no store fetch, no scan, no login. Advisory; ARC stops before payment. Every answer carries checked_at (the saved check it rests on; for a list, the oldest) and stale (true when that check is 24 hours old or older, or has no time). Errors: {error:{code, message, next_step}}.
